annotation.title_clean: ISO/IEC 38507:2022 - Information technology — Governance of IT — Governance implications of the use of artificial intelligence by organizations
annotation.title_en: ISO/IEC 38507:2022 - Information technology — Governance of IT — Governance implications of the use of artificial intelligence by organizations
annotation.authors_or_issuer: ISO/IEC (International Organization for Standardization / International Electrotechnical Commission)
annotation.summary_en: ISO store page for ISO/IEC 38507:2022, an international standard giving guidance to governing bodies on governing organizational use of AI so it is effective, efficient and acceptable. Applies to any organization; the page shows only the abstract and lifecycle metadata.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidance for governing bodies to enable and govern AI use in organizations
Also addresses executives, specialists, policymakers, service providers and auditors
Applies to current and future AI uses in organizations of any size or sector
